segments.ja528:1.1: “Kiṃ nu daṇḍaṃ kimajinaṃ, kiṃ chattaṃ kimupāhanaṃ;
segments.ja528:1.5: Taramānarūpohāsi [gaṇhāsi (sī. syā. pī.)], kiṃ nu patthayase disaṃ”.
segments.ja528:3.3: Tava sutvā sabhariyassa, vītasaddhassa maṃ pati”.
segments.ja528:4.1: “Ahu esa kato doso, yathā bhāsasi brāhmaṇa;
segments.ja528:4.3: Esa bhiyyo pasīdāmi, vasa brāhmaṇa māgamā”.
segments.ja528:6.1: “Abbhantaraṃ pure āsi, tato majjhe tato bahi;
segments.ja528:9.3: Asappurisadhammo so, yo bhajantaṃ na bhajjati [bhājati (pī.)].
segments.ja528:10.1: “Yo bhajantaṃ na bhajati, sevamānaṃ na sevati;
segments.ja528:10.3: Sa ve manussapāpiṭṭho, migo sākhassito yathā.
segments.ja528:11.3: Etena mittā jīranti, akāle yācanāya ca.
segments.ja528:12.1: “Tasmā nābhikkhaṇaṃ gacche, na ca gacche cirāciraṃ;
segments.ja528:12.3: Kālena yācaṃ yāceyya, evaṃ mittā na jīyare [jīrare (syā. pī.)].
segments.ja528:13.3: Āmanta kho taṃ gacchāma, purā te homa appiyā”.
segments.ja528:14.3: Paricārakānaṃ sataṃ [paricārikānaṃ sattānaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)], vacanaṃ na karosi no;
segments.ja528:14.5: Evaṃ taṃ abhiyācāma, puna kayirāsi pariyāyaṃ”.
segments.ja528:15.1: “Evaṃ ce no viharataṃ, antarāyo na hessati;
segments.ja528:15.3: Tuyhaṃ vāpi [tumhañcāpi (sī.), tuyhañcāpi (pī.)] mahārāja, mayhaṃ vā [amhaṃ vā (sī.), mayhañca (pī.)] raṭṭhavaddhana;
segments.ja528:16.3: Akāmā akaraṇīyaṃ vā, karaṇīyaṃ vāpi kubbati;
segments.ja528:17.1: “So ce attho ca dhammo ca, kalyāṇo na ca pāpako;
segments.ja528:17.3: Bhoto ce vacanaṃ saccaṃ, suhato vānaro mayā.
segments.ja528:18.1: “Attano ce hi vādassa, aparādhaṃ vijāniyā [vijāniya (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja528:18.3: Na maṃ tvaṃ garaheyyāsi, bhoto vādo hi tādiso”.
segments.ja528:20.1: “So ce attho ca dhammo ca, kalyāṇo na ca pāpako;
segments.ja528:20.3: Bhoto ce vacanaṃ saccaṃ, suhato vānaro mayā.
segments.ja528:21.3: Na maṃ tvaṃ garaheyyāsi, bhoto vādo hi tādiso”.
segments.ja528:22.3: Porāṇakaṃ kataṃ pāpaṃ, tameso muccate [muñcate (sī. syā.)] iṇaṃ;
segments.ja528:23.1: “So ce attho ca dhammo ca, kalyāṇo na ca pāpako;
segments.ja528:23.3: Bhoto ce vacanaṃ saccaṃ, suhato vānaro mayā.
segments.ja528:24.3: Na maṃ tvaṃ garaheyyāsi, bhoto vādo hi tādiso”.
segments.ja528:25.5: Idheva jīvati jīvo, pecca pecca vinassati.
segments.ja528:26.1: Ucchijjati ayaṃ loko, ye bālā ye ca paṇḍitā;
segments.ja528:27.1: “So ce attho ca dhammo ca, kalyāṇo na ca pāpako;
segments.ja528:27.3: Bhoto ce vacanaṃ saccaṃ, suhato vānaro mayā.
segments.ja528:28.3: Na maṃ tvaṃ garaheyyāsi, bhoto vādo hi tādiso”.
segments.ja528:29.1: “Āhu khattavidā [khattavidhā (sī. syā. pī.)] loke, bālā paṇḍitamānino.
segments.ja528:29.3: Mātaraṃ pitaraṃ haññe, atho jeṭṭhampi bhātaraṃ;
segments.ja528:29.5: Haneyya putta [putte ca (pī.)] dāre ca, attho ce tādiso siyā.
segments.ja528:30.3: Na tassa sākhaṃ bhañjeyya, mittadubbho [mittadūbhī (pī.)] hi pāpako.
segments.ja528:31.3: Attho me sambalenāpi, suhato vānaro mayā.
segments.ja528:32.1: [ayaṃ gāthā sīhaḷapotthake natthi]“So ce attho ca dhammo ca, kalyāṇo na ca pāpako;
segments.ja528:32.3: Bhoto ce vacanaṃ saccaṃ, suhato vānaro mayā [ayaṃ gāthā sīhaḷapotthake natthi].
segments.ja528:33.3: Na maṃ tvaṃ garaheyyāsi, bhoto vādo hi tādiso.
segments.ja528:34.3: Pubbekatī ca ucchedī, yo ca khattavido naro.
segments.ja528:35.3: Kareyya tādiso pāpaṃ, atho aññampi kāraye;
segments.ja528:36.1: “Urabbharūpena vakassu [bakāsu (sī. syā.), vakāsu (pī.)] pubbe, asaṃkito ajayūthaṃ upeti;
segments.ja528:36.3: Hantvā uraṇiṃ ajikaṃ [ajiyaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] ajañca, utrāsayitvā [citrāsayitvā (sī. pī.)] yena kāmaṃ paleti.
segments.ja528:38.3: Kareyya tādiso pāpaṃ, atho aññampi kāraye;
segments.ja528:39.1: “Yamāhu natthi vīriyanti, ahetuñca pavadanti [hetuñca apavadanti (sī. syā. pī.)] ye;
segments.ja528:40.3: Kareyya tādiso pāpaṃ, atho aññampi kāraye;
segments.ja528:41.3: Na bhare vaḍḍhakiṃ rājā, napi yantāni kāraye.
segments.ja528:42.3: Tasmā yantāni kāreti, rājā bharati vaḍḍhakiṃ.
segments.ja528:43.1: “Yadi vassasataṃ devo, na vasse na himaṃ pate;
segments.ja528:43.3: Ucchijjeyya ayaṃ loko, vinasseyya ayaṃ pajā.
segments.ja528:44.3: Tasmā sassāni paccanti, raṭṭhañca pālite [pallate (sī. pī.), polayate (syā.)] ciraṃ.
segments.ja528:45.3: Sabbā tā jimhaṃ gacchanti, nette jimhaṃ [jimha (pī.)] gate sati.
segments.ja528:46.3: So ce adhammaṃ carati, pageva itarā pajā;
segments.ja528:46.5: Sabbaṃ raṭṭhaṃ dukhaṃ seti, rājā ce hoti adhammiko.
segments.ja528:47.3: Sabbā gāvī ujuṃ yanti, nette ujuṃ [ujū (pī.)] gate sati.
segments.ja528:48.3: So sace [ceva (sī.), cepi (ka.)] dhammaṃ carati, pageva itarā pajā;
segments.ja528:48.5: Sabbaṃ raṭṭhaṃ sukhaṃ seti, rājā ce hoti dhammiko.
segments.ja528:53.3: Sabbosadhīhi so rājā, viruddho hoti khattiyo.
segments.ja528:55.3: Ussite hiṃsayaṃ rājā, sa balena virujjhati.
segments.ja528:57.1: “Yo ca rājā adhammaṭṭho, bhariyaṃ hanti adūsikaṃ;
segments.ja528:57.3: Luddaṃ pasavate ṭhānaṃ [pāpaṃ (sī.)], puttehi ca virujjhati.
segments.ja528:58.3: Isayo ca na hiṃseyya, puttadāre samaṃ care.
segments.ja528:59.3: Sapatte [sāmante (sī. syā. pī.)] sampakampeti, indova asurādhipo”ti.
segments.ja528:63.3: Tatiyo pana bodhisirīvhayano, kathitā pana tīṇi jinena subhāti.
